# Model Commands

Every command the `model` module offers, from its declarations, in order of the resource each acts on. Each command's help says the same.

## Model

### `lnk model chat`

Ask the model, with one typed request and response stream

```usage
lnk model chat [--json] [--request <request>]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `--request`, string: JSON request file (default: standard input). It answers `model.stream`.

### `lnk model context`

What the calling agent’s context is spent on, part by part

```usage
lnk model context [--chat <chat>] [--json]
```

It takes `--chat`, string: The chat to report, as the list of chats names it (default: the latest). It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It answers `model.context`.

### `lnk model count`

Count text with the model tokenizer

```usage
lnk model count [--json] [--request <request>]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `--request`, string: JSON request file (default: standard input). It answers `model.counted`.

### `lnk model delete`

Delete a model from Ollama

```usage
lnk model delete <model> [--yes]
```

It takes `model`, position 1, string, required: The model, as `lnk model list` names it (qwen3 finds qwen3:8b). It takes `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask. It answers `core.report`.

### `lnk model embed`

Embed texts with the granted model

```usage
lnk model embed [--json] [--request <request>]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `--request`, string: JSON request file (default: standard input). It answers `model.embedded`.

### `lnk model install`

Install a model (and Ollama, if it's missing)

```usage
lnk model install [model] [--yes]
```

It takes `model`, position 1, string: A model (`lnk model list`); one not there comes from Ollama's library, e.g. qwen3:8b. It takes `--yes`, boolean: Say yes to what it would ask. It answers `core.report`.

### `lnk model list`

List plain model names, from the granted provider or this machine

```usage
lnk model list [--fit] [--json] [--start]
```

- `--fit`, boolean: Only the model that suits this machine, the one `lnk model install` picks, and why
- `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs
- `--start`, boolean: Start Ollama first if it's installed but not running, so its models are listed too

It answers `model.names`.

### `lnk model serve`

Serve a model's OpenAI-compatible API on a local port

```usage
lnk model serve [--json] [--model <model>] [--port <port>] [--upstream <upstream>]
```

- `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs
- `--model`, string: A model of `lnk model list`: serve just this one. Requests use it whatever model they ask for, and `/v1/models` lists only it [default: every model of the runtime]
- `--port`, integer, default `0`: Port on 127.0.0.1 [default: any free one]
- `--upstream`, string: Base URL of the model runtime, e.g. http://localhost:9000 [default: the one running on this machine, see `lnk model list`]

It answers `model.serving`.

### `lnk model show`

What Link knows of a model: its window, longest answer, how it thinks, and its price

```usage
lnk model show [model] [--json]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `model`, position 1, string: Model name required for owner inspection; omitted in an agent namespace to inspect its selected model. It answers `model.shown`.

### `lnk model transcribe`

Transcribe audio with the granted provider

```usage
lnk model transcribe [--json] [--request <request>]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `--request`, string: JSON request file (default: standard input). It answers `model.heard`.

### `lnk model usage`

The calling agent’s measured model usage

```usage
lnk model usage [--json]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It answers `model.usage`.

## Runtime

### `lnk model runtime add`

Add a model runtime at an address of its own

```usage
lnk model runtime add <url> [--name <name>]
```

It takes `--name`, string, default `Your server`: What `lnk model runtime list` calls it. It takes `url`, position 1, string, required: Its address on this machine, e.g. http://localhost:5000. It answers `core.report`.

### `lnk model runtime list`

List the model runtimes on this machine, and the models each runs

```usage
lnk model runtime list [--json] [--start]
```

It takes `--json`, boolean: Print the answer as JSON for other programs. It takes `--start`, boolean: Start Ollama first if it's installed but not running, so its models are listed too. It answers `model.runtimes`.

### `lnk model runtime remove`

Remove a runtime `lnk model runtime add` added

```usage
lnk model runtime remove <name>
```

It takes `name`, position 1, string, required: The name `lnk model runtime add` gave it (`lnk model runtime list`). It answers `core.report`.
